title: guarea glabra subsp. tuerckheimii
intro: Guarea glabra subsp. tuerckheimii, commonly known as a tree species within the family Meliaceae, is a plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Guarea glabra subsp. tuerckheimii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress, making it a potential remedy for conditions like arthritis and respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of Guarea glabra subsp. tuerckheimii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
